about: Added (free) sugar per 100 g as eaten (F22). INS has no sugar column, so every packaged or prepared food is listed here; label foods take it from their label; any other food has none. INS foods outside the curated seed use their id ins-<code>; "doubtful" marks an estimate the owner should check against a label.
